news.title: O'Neill School researchers to shine at ABFM Conference
news.summary_en: O’Neill School public finance scholars will present research and earn honors at the 2026 ABFM Conference, highlighting leadership in budgeting and financial management.

news.title: Kim honored by ABFM with prestigious Michael Curro Award
news.summary_en: O’Neill Ph.D. candidate Sewon Kim earns the Michael Curro Best Student Paper Award for research on improving local government financial management.
